- Initial release of phy-css-dead-code, an unused CSS detector and dead selector auditor.
- Scans all CSS, SCSS, Sass, Less, and framework files against HTML, JSX, TSX, Vue, and template files to find unused selectors.
- Detects major CSS frameworks (Tailwind, Bootstrap, CSS Modules, vanilla, Sass/SCSS) and applies framework-specific analysis.
- Reports estimated byte savings per dead rule, flags !important overuse, duplicates, and orphaned media queries.
- Generates safe-deletion plans with exact grep verification commands; no external APIs required (uses only npx and grep).
- Works out-of-the-box with zero config or build steps.
